name: The Dog House – Royal Hunt

features.name: Wild multipliers
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 carry 2x or 3x multipliers that combine on the same line.

features.name: Free spins reveal
features.description: A 3x3 grid determines the number of free spins, up to 27.

features.name: Sticky wilds
features.description: Wilds that land in the bonus stay put with their multipliers until the round ends.

review:
The Dog House – Royal Hunt dresses the classic format in medieval finery. Wilds land on reels 2, 3 and 4 carrying random 2x or 3x multipliers, and when more than one is part of a winning line their values combine, which is how the biggest line wins are built.

The free spins trigger needs bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5. Before the round starts, a separate 3x3 grid spins to decide how many free games you get, with up to 27 possible. Any wilds that land during the bonus become sticky and keep their multipliers until the end, so the spin count you receive has a big influence on the outcome. Pragmatic Play advertises a 8,000x top win. If you liked the original Dog House, this plays very similarly but with the random spin-count reveal adding an extra moment of suspense.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
